messages:
Ashley (support): quick heads-up, customer Sofia hit intermittent 400s when invoking our price tool and reported a billing spike from retries. repro steps and sample req below — escalating for triage
Sofia (customer): repro: POST /v1/invoke -> body:
```
{
  \"tool\": \"price_lookup\",
  \"args\": {\"item_id\": \"SKU-123\", \"currency\": \"USD\"}
}
```
Response: 400 `InvalidArguments: schema mismatch for args.price` — our SDK retried ~3x and that bumped the token/billing. happened across multiple regions (us-west1, eu-west1).
Miguel (eng-runtime): thanks — can you paste the failing request id from the customer's last attempt? also any stack trace?
Ashley (support): req_id: rQ7f9a2f-331; pasted logs from gateway: `TOOL_INVOKE_FAILED: code=TOOL_ARGS_MISMATCH, expected number for price but got string` — but the request above didn't include price, just item_id/currency. looks like selector inserted a `price` field as string somewhere.
Priya (eng-ml): hmm that suggests model-to-tool arg mapping changed. Did we recently push a function signature tweak in the price tool? Also seeing similar failures in the tool-calling golden eval on CI earlier today.
Daniel (devex): I saw CI noise at 06:14 UTC — job `eval-toolcall-regression` had 4 failing cases, all around price tool. Failure message in CI: `SchemaValidationError: missing required field: price` for the golden prompt `pricing:single-sku`.
Miguel (eng-runtime): digging into runtime traces — the router is sending args as a single string when `temperature` sampling is non-zero and model returns structured JSON inside a top-level string token. Example model output we saw in logs:
```
{\"tool\": \"price_lookup\", \"args\": \"{\\\"item_id\\\": \\\"SKU-123\\\", \\\"currency\\\": \\\"USD\\\"}\"}
```
So the args field is a JSON-encoded string, not an object. Our schema validator treats that as mismatch.
Ashley (support): that aligns with the customer's payload — their SDK didn't JSON-encode args as string, but the model/selector returned a string-encoded args which runtime forwarded as-is. Customer saw 400, then retried which counted as extra invocations.
Priya (eng-ml): likely regression introduced by the model-serialization patch in the selector layer (PR #487). The golden eval probably should have caught it but the test only asserts tool name not arg types.
Daniel (devex): action items: 1) add CI golden that asserts `args` JSON type for price_lookup and a few other tools, 2) add a quick parser in runtime to attempt safe JSON parse when args is a string to avoid hard 400s, 3) rollback selector change if needed. I'll open a small PR for the CI test.
Miguel (eng-runtime): temporary mitigation: will add defensive parsing in the runtime (if args is string, try JSON.parse, if parse succeeds, forward object). I'll push a canary fix to us-west1.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime/defensive-parse @ canary-group-us-west1.
Ashley (support): updated customer, they confirmed reduced 400s after canary. Still want a full fix and preventing regression in CI. Also need a billing credit review — can we waive extra retry charges for Sofia?
Priya (eng-ml): opening an internal bug INFR-457 referencing PR #487 and linking CI failures. I'll attach failing model outputs and golden eval trace.
Miguel (eng-runtime): opened bug INF-457 and put `priority:high`; assigned to @miguel. Will monitor canary and post logs.
Daniel (devex): PR for CI tests opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/229 — adds type assertions to golden prompts and a smoke for string-encoded args.
Ashley (support): thank you — closing loop with Sofia and filing for billing credit. Will reopen if we see any regression. :thumbsup:
Sofia (customer): confirmed things look better, thanks for quick response! :heart:
